title: TMAS: Scaling Test-Time Compute via Multi-Agent Synergy
authors_zh: George Wu、Nan Jing、Qing Yi、Chuan Hao、Ming Yang、Feng Chang、Yuan Wei、Ran Tao、Bryan Dai（IQuest Research）；Jian Yang（北京航空航天大学）
paper_type_zh: 多智能体迭代测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 设计长程推理中探索、验证与记忆复用协同机制的读者。
one_line: TMAS coordinates parallel solution, verification, summarization, and two memory banks so later test-time iterations can reuse reliable progress without repeating strategies.
TMAS 让解答、验证、摘要与双层记忆智能体在多轮推理中协同，从而复用可靠进展并避免重复探索。
why: It treats cross-trajectory information retention as a controllable test-time resource rather than leaving parallel rollouts independent.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly scales test-time computation through coordinated multi-agent trajectories, verification passes, and reusable cross-iteration memory.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Parallel reasoning trajectories can improve difficult answers, but independent rollouts often repeat the same mistake or discard useful intermediate discoveries after one attempt. Historical-memory approaches may retain too much noisy information, while verify-refine pipelines may provide feedback without deciding which local findings and global strategies deserve reuse in later iterations.

TMAS asks how test-time computation can be coordinated across agents, trajectories, and refinement rounds. Its target is an iterative system that both exploits verified intermediate progress and deliberately explores strategies not already exhausted, so that more agent calls become a structured search budget rather than a collection of disconnected answers.

并行推理轨迹可以改善困难问题的答案，但彼此独立的 rollout 常重复同一种错误，或在一次尝试后丢弃有价值的中间发现。历史记忆方法可能保留过多噪声信息；验证—细化流水线也可能给出反馈，却没有决定哪些局部发现和全局策略值得在后续迭代中复用。

TMAS 研究如何在智能体、轨迹和细化轮次之间协调测试时计算。其目标是一个迭代系统：既利用已验证的中间进展，也刻意探索尚未耗尽的策略，使更多智能体调用成为结构化搜索预算，而非一堆互不相干的答案。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
TMAS combines parallel exploration with sequential exploitation through five roles: solution, verification, summary, experience, and guideline agents. Every solution trajectory receives multiple verification passes and a compact summary. An experience bank stores reliable low-level conclusions, reusable skills, and identified mistakes; a guideline bank stores higher-level solution directions and already explored strategies.

The two memories have different jobs. Later agents use the experience bank to refine promising work, while the guideline bank redirects exploratory rollouts away from redundant patterns. Hybrid-RL then trains behavior to preserve basic correctness, use the accumulated experience, and explore beyond prior strategies. Thus the scaled record is not just a set of candidates but an evolving, selectively retained multi-agent history.

TMAS 通过五种角色把并行探索和顺序利用结合起来：解答、验证、摘要、经验和指南智能体。每条解答轨迹接受多次验证并得到紧凑摘要。经验库保存可靠的低层结论、可复用技能和已识别错误；指南库保存更高层的解题方向和已探索策略。

两类记忆承担不同职责。后续智能体用经验库细化有希望的工作，用指南库把探索轨迹从重复模式中引开。Hybrid-RL 再训练行为，以保持基本正确性、使用累积经验并探索先前策略之外的路线。因此被扩展的记录不只是候选集合，而是一段不断演化、选择性保留的多智能体历史。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each problem and iteration, a solution agent produces N trajectories in parallel. A verification agent performs M independent checks on each trajectory, returning analytical feedback and scores. A summary agent condenses those checks into a rollout-level record. The experience and guideline agents then update their separate banks from the collection of rollout-summary pairs, and both banks condition the next iteration.

The solution policy uses an exploration coefficient: one branch conditions on prior rollouts and experience for refinement, while another follows the guideline bank to seek non-redundant routes. Hybrid-RL adds incentives beyond final correctness for useful experience consumption and novel strategy exploration. Evaluation reports iterative scaling on reasoning benchmarks, and the official repository supplies code and data for checking the agent prompts, memory updates, and budget configuration.

对每个问题和迭代，解答智能体并行产生 N 条轨迹。验证智能体对每条轨迹进行 M 次独立检查，返回分析反馈和分数。摘要智能体把这些检查压缩为 rollout 级记录。经验与指南智能体随后从“轨迹—摘要”对集合更新各自记忆库，两类记忆共同条件化下一次迭代。

解答策略使用探索系数：一个分支基于先前 rollout 和经验进行细化，另一个分支遵循指南库寻找不重复路线。Hybrid-RL 在最终正确性之外，奖励有用的经验消费和新的策略探索。评测报告推理基准上的迭代扩展，官方仓库提供代码和数据，可检查智能体提示、记忆更新和预算配置。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The front-page result on IMO-AnswerBench reports that TMAS raises Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 pass@1 from 64.9 to 77.2. With Hybrid-RL, the reported Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 result rises from 53.5 to 73.5. These are direct evidence for the paper's claim that structured multi-agent iteration can improve the quality of a fixed reasoning backbone under added test-time work.

The paper also reports stronger iterative scaling and stability than its test-time baselines. The comparison should nevertheless be read as a joint system result: gains may reflect the number of agents, verifier calls, memory context, and RL training together. Reuse should therefore report all of those costs rather than attribute the full change to memory reuse alone.

首页在 IMO-AnswerBench 上报告，TMAS 将 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 的 pass@1 从 64.9 提升到 77.2。加入 Hybrid-RL 后，论文报告 Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 从 53.5 提升到 73.5。这直接支持论文的主张：在追加测试时工作后，结构化多智能体迭代可以改善固定推理骨干的质量。

论文还报告相对测试时基线更强的迭代扩展与稳定性。但该比较应被理解为联合系统结果：收益可能同时来自智能体数量、验证调用、记忆上下文和 RL 训练。复用时应报告所有这些成本，而不应把全部变化只归因于记忆复用。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior parallel scaling often aggregates completed answers, and prior memory methods can accumulate trajectory history without a clear retention policy. TMAS changes the reusable object into two explicit memory layers: local verified signals are separated from global strategic coverage. It also makes role-specialization and cross-iteration communication part of the inference allocation mechanism rather than an informal prompt recipe.

The novel claim is not that more agents universally improve reasoning. It is that selective memory and an exploration-exploitation split let multiple agents use a larger budget more coherently. The key audit questions are whether the verifier genuinely filters errors, whether the banks avoid propagating stale conclusions, and whether the reported gain survives equalized context and call budgets.

既有并行扩展常聚合完成答案，既有记忆方法则可能积累轨迹历史而没有清晰的保留策略。TMAS 把可复用对象改成两层显式记忆：局部已验证信号与全局策略覆盖被分开。它还把角色分工和跨迭代通信变成推理分配机制的一部分，而不是非正式提示配方。

新意并非宣称更多智能体总能改善推理，而是选择性记忆和探索—利用分工能让多个智能体更连贯地使用更大预算。关键审计问题是验证器是否真的过滤错误、记忆库是否避免传播陈旧结论，以及所报告收益能否在上下文和调用预算对齐后仍成立。

title: Limitations
局限
html: TMAS can multiply cost through N solution trajectories, M verification passes, five specialized roles, and repeated memory-conditioned iterations. An incorrect verification or misleading summary can be promoted into memory and contaminate later reasoning, while long memory contexts may dilute or override useful problem-specific evidence. Hybrid-RL further makes it difficult to isolate how much gain comes from inference coordination versus training. Production use should impose memory provenance, expiry, and per-role cost limits.
TMAS 的成本可能因 N 条解答轨迹、M 次验证、五种专门角色和重复的记忆条件迭代而倍增。错误验证或误导摘要可能被提升进记忆，并污染后续推理；过长记忆上下文也可能稀释或覆盖有用的特定问题证据。Hybrid-RL 又使推理协调和训练各自贡献多少收益更难分离。生产使用应限制记忆来源、过期时间和每类角色成本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use TMAS when a reasoning task benefits from several attempts but each attempt contains information that later attempts should reuse or avoid. Log the complete rollout, verification set, summary, bank update, and agent-call cost for every iteration; this is necessary to audit whether a final answer used verified progress or merely accumulated persuasive text. The official repository is the appropriate entry point, but deployment should first compare against a same-call-budget independent-rollout baseline.
当推理任务受益于多次尝试，且每次尝试包含后续尝试应复用或避免的信息时，可使用 TMAS。每次迭代都应记录完整 rollout、验证集合、摘要、记忆库更新和智能体调用成本；这是审计最终答案是利用了已验证进展，还是仅累积了有说服力文本所必需的。官方仓库是正确入口，但部署前应先与相同调用预算的独立 rollout 基线比较。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: TMAS scales an iterative collaboration graph, not only a sample count. The experience bank retains local validated details and errors; the guideline bank records broad directions and prevents repeated strategies. Hybrid-RL is part of the reported performance package, so do not read the headline as a pure inference-only comparison. The strongest empirical numbers are on IMO-AnswerBench, and the public repository is needed to inspect the actual call budget and memory prompts.
TMAS 扩展的是迭代协作图，而不只是样本数量。经验库保留局部已验证细节和错误；指南库记录广泛方向并阻止重复策略。Hybrid-RL 是所报告性能包的一部分，因此不要把标题结果读作纯推理比较。最强经验数字来自 IMO-AnswerBench，检查实际调用预算和记忆提示需要查看公开仓库。
